summary: Tray glyphs by state, live per-file progress, bulk conflict resolution, wizard lists remote folders, avatar fetch wired, and transient keyring failures now retry instead of latching auth-required.
changelog: Tray glyphs distinguish syncing, problems, unconfigured and all-synced states.
Folder rows show live per-file progress while a synchronization is running.
Bulk conflict resolution: keep local or remote for all conflicts at once.
The add-folder dialog lists existing remote folders (Nextcloud) instead of typing the path.
Account avatar is fetched and cached; image bodies on 404 are trusted.
Transient keyring failures (Unavailable/Locked) are retried on the next trigger instead of latching auth-required.
The tray menu is shorter (Open / Log / Quit); account summary is two lines with an accented Add Folder button.
